tasks.objective: Urgently fix the PO-observed N73 failure: copying a distribution to other fifth-grade classes throws تعذّر التحقق من ملكية مساحة العمل before the review. Source cause is directly visible on published main: src/store.js requireDistributionAccount calls runtimeSyncOwnershipGuard.cloudAccess({operation:'dispatch',authenticatedUserId:cloud.user.id}) WITHOUT a command. In src/lib/sync-ownership.js dispatch intentionally requires command.ownerId, so even a valid claimed matching-owner account is rejected as command-owner-missing. Determine the proper non-mutation eligibility/preflight operation for plan/read using the existing guard contract; actual apply must still dispatch an exact owner-bound durable command. Do NOT weaken the guard, fake a successful result or drop account/workspace/lease/recovery/outbox checks. Trace both reviewScoreDistributionCopy and applyReviewedScoreDistribution, including multi-target selection, then add an actual store/UI account-context regression that the previous direct-engine test missed. Preserve every already published N73/N94/N77/N98 behavior.
acceptance: Before modification reproduce the exact valid-owner failure through the ACTUAL current store and runtime ownership guard. A fresh valid account workspace with matching auth, valid N49 lease, syncEligible true and clean outbox must reach review without the erroneous ownership message. Do not mock or override cloudAccess/requireDistributionAccount/set their allowed result. Use isolated synthetic HTTP account responses/fixtures without reading or modifying the user's real account or personal browser.

Run the actual distribution UI review/confirm/store/engine flow against bounded synthetic transport: source→one or multiple eligible target classes, preserve existing target grades and extras, clamp only where current approved contract requires, repeat the accepted command without duplicate writes, show failed/stale plan distinctly. Keep owner-bound command creation and real dispatch validation unchanged. Reuse previous exact native SQL/actual A/B proof where unchanged instead of provisioning any new accounts or replaying migrations.

Negative tests: mismatched owner or workspace, unauthenticated/unknown context, ownerless dispatch command, pending claim recovery, expired/read-only lease and pending outbox remain fail-closed with zero server mutation attempts. Use the public APIs and actual import graph rather than a lookalike function. Preserve the established return type/async contract. Source change should be as small as the proven cause permits.

No SQL/Auth/RLS/DDL, new live fixture, private account data or service secret access. No forced refresh/logout/claim/restore/clearing the user's devices. No manual score distribution on the user's fifth/9 or other real class. Local tests and code only; the sole publisher delivers Production after actual named checks. If another independent defect appears, retain it in evidence and fix within affected UI/store scope rather than assert the complete feature works from a one-line check.
